Sajday Mein Sitamgar Ne Kaisa Yeh Sitam Dhaya Zakhmi Hain Ali Maula.
Hai Haal Bura Gham Se Har Aik Namazi Ka Zakhmi Hain Ali Maula.
Sajday Mein Lagi Zarbat Shabeer Ke Baba Ke.
Sajday Mein Katay Ga Sar Baba Ka Sakina Ke.
Woh Karb-o-Bala Ho Gi Haan Yeh Hai Magar Kofa.
Haider Ne Kaha Mat Ro Ahsan Karo Logo.
Sun Le Na Kahin Zainab Khamosh Raho Logo.
Masjid Mein Na Aa Jaye Aisay Na Karo Giriya.
Baba Ke Qareeb Aaye Jab Rotay Hoye Shabar.
Baba Ka Shikasta Sar Rakhne Lagay Zanu Par.
Sarwar Ne Kaha Ro Kar Aaram Se Aye Bhaiyya.
Woh Chain Se Soye Hain Sab Apni Panahon Mein.
Main Dekh Na Paon Ga Gham Unn Ki Nigahon Mein.
Kofay Ke Yateemo Se Yeh Baat Chupa Lena.
Hai Shoor Yeh Masjid Mein Yeh Zulm Howa Kaisa.
Aayi Na Qayamat Kyun Aye Mere Khuda Batla.
Hai Khon Musalay Par Hasnain Ke Baba Ka.
Betay Se Ali Bolay Tum Fikar Meri Choro.
Aye Beta Hasan Dedo Takmeel Ibadat Ko.
Sar Khon Mein Doba Hai Kartay Hain Sabhi Noha.
:ZEESHAN-o-HASAN: Giriya Barhta Jo Nazar Aaya.
Har Aik Namazi Se Haider Ne Yeh Farmaya.
Hai Meri Qasam Tum Ko Ab Our Nahi Kehna.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 23 Urdu verses of “Zakhmi Hain Ali Maula” and verified that they align with the Roman transcription under the same stanza number. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, added the Urdu title, set right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Ahsan” as `احسان` in “احسان کرو لوگو.” Only the selected lyric was edited.
